title: paper
description: The paper's version record (Implementation Decision 17; ticket 115): research/paper/paper.json, written only by wayline.paper through the ledger at each paper order, beside PAPER.md, the build report rendered from it. Each part carries the version it was last made in, what its inputs hashed to then (a re-order recomposes only the parts whose inputs changed, the title and abstract whenever a main-text part did), and what its file hashed to as code wrote it, so an owner's edit of a part whose inputs did not change is kept. The previous version is frozen under research/paper/earlier/v<n>/.

order.description: the paper order that made this version

commit.description: the commit of main the paper was composed from

composed.description: when, as the journal spells a timestamp

model.description: the writer session's model, null when no part needed one

tables.description: the figure plan's tables (T<n>, supplementary ST<n>) and then the writer's

figures.description: the figure plan this version followed and its figures (ticket 116): each figure's plan line, the figure role's id and status, and the key a re-order compares to reuse a verified figure

answers.description: the batch's answers the composition followed, or code's defaults where no batch was asked

unchecked.description: with no inherited result verified, whether the unchecked ones were kept as stated or left out; null when one was verified or none is inherited

reworded.description: the owner's passages the paper does not carry word for word

kept_edits.description: the parts whose owner's edit was kept

gated.description: false until a build's gates judged this version

code.description: code's steps at the order (ticket 119): the tag paper-N on main, the commit it is at, whether the code repository's split was pushed with it, and the record of the steps (research/orders/<N>/code.json); null when code took none

usage.description: the writer session's token usage, its turns, and its duration

version.description: the version this part was last made in

inputs.description: what the part's inputs hashed to when it was made

sha256.description: the part's file as code wrote it
